name: orphan-disease-opportunity-mcp
description: Myelofibrosis (JAK2+ & Autoimmune MF) flagship playbooks + live 7,000-orphan-disease diligence MCP.
long_description: Zero-dependency, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP 2026-07-28 & 2025-11-25) server for high-tractability orphan disease translational and venture blueprints (Flagships: Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis + Iron/Hepcidin Axis), 30/60/90-day diligence roadmaps, FDA Orphan Drug economics, non-dilutive grants, and ethical patient-community guardrails.

tools.name: list_non_dilutive_grants

tools.name: get_validation_communities
